chapter.heading: Isaiah 52
The LORD’s Coming Salvation
chapter.v: For thus says the Lord :“ You were sold for nothing , andyou shall be redeemed without money . ”
For thus says the Lord God :“ My people went down at the first into Egypt to sojourn there , and the Assyrian oppressed them for nothing .

Now therefore what have I here , ” declares the Lord , “ seeing that my people are taken away for nothing ? Their rulers wail , ” declares the Lord , “ andcontinually all the day my name is despised .
Therefore my people shall know my name .Therefore in that day they shall know that it is I who speak ; here I am . ”
who says to Zion , “ Your God reigns . ”
the return of the Lord to Zion .
you who bear the vessels of the Lord .
and the God of Israel will be your rear guard .
and his form beyond that of the children of mankind —
and that which they have not heard they understand .
